    args=["curl","-s","-X","POST","https://slack.com/api/users.list","-H","Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>","--data","limit=200"]

    cursor=d.get("response_metadata",{}).get("next_cursor")
    if not cursor: break
print("FOUND:", found if found else "no users with 'aisha' in name")
EOF
